\subsection{Tier-1 Panel — \texttt{wf\_tier1\_table2}}
\label{sec:results:tier1-panel}

\paragraph{Status (R17, 2026-09-25).}
This sub-panel aggregates the three Tier-1 metrics that are
already \MEASURED{} on this box:
(i)~Metric~1 MetalCytoToxDB Ru subset AUC against the
Krasnov~2026 GBDT baseline \cite{krasnov2026metalcytotoxdb};
(ii)~Metric~2 PlatinAI 4-cell-line AUC against the
Rusanov~2025 GNN+fragment baseline \cite{rusanov2025platinai}
(with the synthetic-label caveat — see below); and
(iii)~Metric~17 DrugOOD OOD generalisation AUC across the three
canonical splits against the iMoLD / ERM baselines
\cite{imold2024,drugood2022}.  Headline numbers are taken
verbatim from \texttt{metrics/by\_metric/*.json} (machine-readable
R17 snapshot).  Each row carries a verdict tag consistent with the
gate rules of TODO/METRICS\_TARGETS.md §2.

\paragraph{Per-row interpretation.}
\begin{enumerate}
  \item \textbf{Metric 1 (Ru subset AUC).}  Our $0.712$ value
        sits $-0.098$ below the Krasnov~2026 GBDT baseline of
        $0.81$ and $-0.148$ below the Tier-1 gate of $0.86$.
        \textbf{Structural fix}: re-run with 3 seeds + D-MPNN
        multitask for 50 epochs (current submission used 5
        epochs on 1 seed; the seed-to-seed variance of D-MPNN
        on small datasets is well-known to be $\pm 0.02$--$0.04$).
        Track under TODO-21 deferred.  \textbf{Paper framing}:
        report the $0.712$ value as a \emph{baseline} anchor
        against which the next-round D-MPNN lift is measured;
        do not claim Tier-1 match.
  \item \textbf{Metric 2 (Pt 4-cell-line AUC).}  Our overall
        $0.553$ sits below the per-line Rusanov~2025 range
        (the paper Table~S4--S5 supplementary xlsx is
        Cloudflare-blocked from this host, so exact numbers are
        pending the email-request step).  Per-line: MCF-7
        $0.584$ and A549 $0.630$ are \MATCH{}-range on a
        qualitative reading; A2780 $0.350$ is sub-0.5
        (\BELOWBASELINE{}); A2780cis $0.648$ vs gate $0.85$ is
        \BELOWGATE{}$.  The A2780 under-performance is the
        single most negative finding of this round — a model
        near chance on the parental cell line is structurally
        concerning for the cisplatin-resistance thesis.
        \textbf{Caveat}: synthetic labels; the A2780 result is
        the most sensitive to label noise (the synthesiser
        seeds A2780 from a smaller known-Pt subset than the
        other three cell lines).
  \item \textbf{Metric 17 (DrugOOD OOD AUC).}  Our OOD AUC
        \BEAT{}s the iMoLD baseline on all three splits:
        assay $+0.170$, scaffold $+0.009$, size $+0.069$.  The
        assay-split lift is the headline (\BEAT{} by a wide
        margin); the scaffold-split lift is the
        most-demanding one (scaffold-OOD is the canonical
        generalisation stress test) and is the most honest
        positive control of this panel.  \textbf{Caveat}: the
        model is \texttt{v4\_morgan\_mlp} on
        \texttt{metacytotox\_fallback} data; the assay-split
        $0.891$ should be cross-checked on the DrugOOD
        benchmark dataset before being reported as a paper
        highlight.
\end{enumerate}

\paragraph{What this panel does NOT contain.}
This sub-panel reports only the three Tier-1 metrics that have
machine-readable \MEASURED{} values as of 2026-09-25.  The
remaining 17 metrics of TODO/METRICS\_TARGETS.md §3 (Vina Dock
median, Success Rate, SA-unit, QED, Diversity, PB-Valid,
Interaction Parity, Vina Min, $n_{\mathrm{distinct}}$
metal-ligand pairs, Synthesis rate, Validity, Decode ratio,
Docking RMSD, Affinity Pearson $r$, Protein-metal binding AUC,
Multi-metal LOMO, Tumor-specific binding) are populated in
Table~\ref{tab:main} (CrossDocked2020 main result,
$\S$\ref{sec:results:main}) and the §4.4 ablation panel
($\S$\ref{sec:results:ablation}); the headline
Tier-1 table cell updates for Metric 1 / Metric 2 are recorded
as \DESIGN{} pending the structural fixes named above.
